notes: Plan section 4 with the corrections of 核查修正. Run when the card is idle:  python run_bench.py cases_4k.json
Run r00*,r01*,r02*,s01*,s02* first, put the winning seed and denoiser into var WIN, then the rest. WIN starts empty, which keeps the approved look: animated seed, OptiX.
Rows 3-6 use --caustics 0, the plan's 4K setting. Rows 1-2 keep the script's caustics so they compare with frames_hq, and r13 is the A/B.

Hardest frames from the logs and frames_hq file times, at 1080p: 1-02 163-170 (17.0 s) against 60-67 (12.9 s), the rows the 1.61 / 0.58 reading is planned on, so both are here. 1-02 plates: 266 (10.7 s) over 450 (7.0 s). 1-04 A: window 254-259 (9.5 s), single peak 160 (15.9 s). 1-04 B: peak 10 (11.8 s). Canvas: 18-23 is the truck's fastest stretch, 79 the static end frame (11.3 s).

Remotion is at 60 fps through the fps prop, so frames are twice the plan's 30-based numbers: 1600 -> 3200, 3600 -> 7200, 3900 -> 7800. No baked-noise plates exist yet, so noiseDir stays null and the live filters are measured.
If time runs out, the plan cuts r10 and r11e first, then r06.

Not in this file: Render Time / Sample Count passes for row 3 (need multilayer EXR and a Blender-side reader), the 90-frame review loop of acceptance rule 6, real 4K phone footage, a real plate warp in Chrome. None of these has code yet.
